newsitem.title: LEBANON: Hizbollah threatens Israel with suicide bombings.
newsitem.headline: Hizbollah threatens Israel with suicide bombings.

text.p: The pro-Iranian Hizbollah on Friday vowed to launch suicide bomb attacks against Israeli forces if they mounted a new military operation in Lebanon.

"I promise and threaten this enemy that any new aggression against Lebanon will drag the occupying Israeli army back into mud and into a quagmire where bombs are not made of iron but of human bodies," Hizbollah chief Sheikh Hassan Nasrallah said.

Nasrallah was speaking at a rally in eastern Lebanon hours after Israeli helicopters attacked suspected Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrilla targets in south Lebanon, heightening fears that Israel may mount a large scale military offensive in Lebanon.

A senior Lebanese Foreign Ministry official said on Thursday that Beirut was taking seriously a warning by Israel's proxy militia in south Lebanon of a possible widescale Israeli retaliation if Hizbollah stepped up attacks on Israeli troops.

But General Antoine Lahd, head of the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia, said on Friday he was not conveying a message from Israel when he made the warning this week, adding it was his personal analysis.

Nasrallah said Hizbollah had weathered two large scale Israeli offensives against them in July 1993 and April 1996 and was ready for any new confrontation. Hizbollah wants to drive Israeli forces from a border zone in south Lebanon.
